title: Massive Coral Formation
description: A towering coral structure rises from the flooded cavern floor, its branches fanning outward in violet and amber. Something glints deep within the lattice, caught between calcified ridges. The sand around the base is littered with shell fragments.

choices.label: Break open the coral
choices.description: A pearl is lodged inside, worth the effort to extract.

outcomes.text: The coral cracks cleanly and a lustrous pearl rolls into your palm. It pulses faintly with tidal energy.
The pearl shatters as you pry it free, but the coral fragments themselves are valuable crafting stock.
The formation collapses in a shower of sharp fragments. A jagged shard slashes across your arm before you can shield yourself.

choices.label: Harvest the coral branches
choices.description: Dried coral is sturdy enough to use as structural wood.

outcomes.text: The outer branches snap off cleanly. Coral-wood is surprisingly light and strong.
Decent haul, though the inner branches are too calcified to be useful.
A nest of electric eels lurks in a hollow at the coral's base. One lashes out with a crackling discharge before you stumble back.

choices.label: Search the sand nearby
choices.description: Coins and trinkets wash up and settle around formations like this.

outcomes.text: Your fingers close around coin after coin. The currents have been depositing treasure here for years.
A few corroded coins and a shell fragment. The sand yields less than you hoped.
You dig up a buried crab that clamps onto your finger. After shaking it off, you find a modest pouch of coin underneath.
